subject: English Core
title: Lost Spring — Prose Chapter 2 - Part 1 (Saheb) DPP

questions.question: Why did Saheb’s family leave their home in Dhaka?
options: Due to war and political unrest
Because storms destroyed their ﬁelds and homes
questions.explanation: Because storms destroyed their ﬁelds and homes

questions.question: Why does the author feel embarrassed when Saheb asks about the school?
options: She never meant her promise seriously
The school was not ready yet
She had no funds to build it
questions.explanation: She never meant her promise seriously

questions.question: Why do some children not wear chappals according to the boys?
options: Their parents can't afford them or they follow tradition
questions.explanation: Their parents can't afford them or they follow tradition

questions.question: What contrast does the author observe in the story from Udipi?
options: Between barefoot boys and those with branded shoes
Between rich priests and poor ragpickers
Between the boy’s childhood prayer for shoes and the current reality of school-going children wearing shoes
Between the temple and the school
questions.explanation: Between the boy’s childhood prayer for shoes and the current reality of school-going children wearing shoes

questions.question: What does Seemapuri lack, despite housing thousands of people?
What do ration cards provide the people of Seemapuri with?
How does garbage hold a different meaning for children than for adults in Seemapuri?
options: It is a game for children
For children, it’s hope and wonder; for adults, it’s survival
Children are unaware of its use
questions.explanation: For children, it’s hope and wonder; for adults, it’s survival

questions.question: Why does Saheb wear tennis shoes even though they don’t match his clothes?
options: He found them in the garbage
